title: NMDC iron ore production rises 31% in July 2026
description: NMDC Limited reported iron ore production of 4.06 million MT in July 2026, a 31% YoY increase. Chhattisgarh led the growth with 2.55 million MT. Cumulative production reached 19.16 million MT, while cumulative sales stood at 15.15 million MT for the period up to July 2026.
